overloadMerges.note: errorText, row, and column all have a <- doc arrow (they are populated by the command), but autoparse's blanket direction:'in' left them as inputs; corrected to 'out'.
overloadMerges.semanticRole: Retrieves a description (and optional row/column location) of the parsing/processing error last encountered for a given XML element reference.

constraints: The error information is supplied by the underlying Xerces.DLL library.
row and column, when passed, receive respectively the row number and the character position (within that row) where the erroring expression begins.
